faq.q: What is included in a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks (tapas-style), insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Champagne is served as part of the drinks package. No hidden costs.

faq.q: Which boats are available for sunset cruises in Marbella?
faq.a: We offer a range: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax), Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax), Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), and smaller boats like Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How much does a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas cost?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) is €4,719 minimum 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Other boats: pricing on request via WhatsApp. All prices include skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT.

faq.q: What time does the sunset cruise depart?
faq.a: Departure times depend on the season. In summer (June–August), sunset is around 21:30, so cruises typically start at 19:30 or 20:00. In spring and autumn, sunset is earlier (19:00–20:30). We adjust to give you prime sunset views from the water.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks on board?
faq.a: Our charters include a full drinks package (champagne, beer, wine, cava, soft drinks) and light tapas-style snacks. You are welcome to bring additional food, but we recommend letting us know in advance. Glassware and coolers are provided.

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for large groups or celebrations?
faq.a: Yes. Boats like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) are ideal for birthdays, anniversaries, or corporate events. The champagne and tapas package adds a celebratory touch. Contact us via WhatsApp for group bookings.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day of my cruise?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If weather conditions (strong winds, storms) make the cruise unsafe, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will inform you at least 24 hours in advance if possible.

faq.q: How do I book a Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: You can book directly via our website or WhatsApp. For Tier A and B boats, select your preferred date and time. For other boats, message us for availability and pricing. A deposit secures your booking, with balance due 7 days before departure.

data.body_html:
Experience the ultimate Marbella sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in 2029. Departing from Puerto Banús, our luxury boats offer an unforgettable evening on the Mediterranean. Watch the sun dip behind La Concha mountain while sipping chilled champagne and enjoying light tapas. Prices start from €749 for 2 hours, with all drinks, snacks, skipper, and VAT included. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a romantic evening, this is the finest way to see Marbella's coastline at golden hour.

Why Choose a Marbella Sunset Cruise with Champagne and Tapas?

A sunset cruise combines the best of Marbella: stunning coastal scenery, luxury boats, and superb hospitality. The champagne and tapas package elevates the experience, turning a simple boat ride into a gourmet evening. Unlike crowded beach clubs, you have the sea to yourself. The calm evening waters around Puerto Banús are perfect for relaxation, and the views of the Golden Mile, Cabopino, and Estepona are breathtaking. With a licensed skipper handling everything, you can simply unwind.

Available Boats for Your Sunset Cruise

We maintain a fleet of well-maintained vessels, all departing from Puerto Banús. Below are the most popular choices for sunset cruises:

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are excellent options. All boats include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for specific dates.

What's Included in Your Evening Experience

Every charter includes a full drinks package: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and champagne. Light tapas-style snacks are provided. The licensed skipper handles navigation and safety. Fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA (21%) are all included. No hidden fees. You can also request additional catering (e.g., full dinner) at an extra cost—just let us know when booking.

Best Time for a Sunset Cruise in Marbella

Sunset times vary by season. In summer (June to August), sunset occurs around 21:30, so we recommend a 19:30 or 20:00 departure. In spring and autumn, sunset is between 19:00 and 20:30. Winter sunsets are earlier (18:00–18:30). We adjust departure times to ensure you catch the best colours. The water temperature in summer averages 24–26 °C, perfect for a dip if you choose a boat with a swim platform.

Suggested Itinerary for Your Evening Cruise

A typical sunset cruise from Puerto Banús heads west towards Estepona or east towards Cabopino. You can anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop (weather permitting). The skipper will recommend the best route based on wind and sea conditions. For a longer cruise, head towards Sotogrande or even Gibraltar on a clear day. All itineraries are flexible—just discuss with your skipper.

How to Book Your Marbella Sunset Cruise

Booking is simple. Visit our main page at Boat Rental Marbella to view the fleet and select your preferred boat. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can book directly online. For other boats, message us on WhatsApp with your desired date, group size, and any special requests. A 50% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance, especially during peak summer months.
